# WA Validator MCP Server

> Hosted MCP server that checks whether phone numbers are registered on WhatsApp. Streamable HTTP, no install.

## Connection
URL: https://wavalidator.com/mcp/
Header: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY (same key as the REST API, from https://wavalidator.com/dashboard/)
Protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 over POST; methods initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call.

## Tools
- check_whatsapp_number {phone_number: string} — 1 credit. Returns {phone_number, status: valid|invalid|error, credits_remaining}.
- bulk_check_whatsapp_numbers {numbers: string[] (max 100)} — 1 credit per number. Returns {checked, invalid, total, credits_used, credits_remaining, results[]}.

Errors (bad key, no credits, rate limit) are returned as tool results with isError: true.

## Links
- Docs: https://wavalidator.com/mcp-docs/
- REST API: https://wavalidator.com/api-docs/
